name: MyScale
tagline: SQL vector database built on ClickHouse — vector, full-text, and analytics in one query.
description: MyScale is a SQL-native vector database built as a ClickHouse fork, so a single SQL statement can combine vector similarity search, full-text search, and standard structured/analytical queries. It is offered as a managed cloud service with a free starter pod, and its core engine, MyScaleDB, is open source. The SQL-first design lets teams join embeddings with their existing relational data without standing up a separate vector store.
insight: MyScaleDB, its ClickHouse-fork engine, was open-sourced under Apache-2.0 in 2024, making SQL-native vector search self-hostable.
edge: Built as a ClickHouse fork, so one SQL query can mix vector search, full-text search, and analytics—no separate vector store to keep in sync.
pros: SQL joins vectors with structured data
cons: SQL-first model has a learning curve
